checks.text: The page shows the heading "EPUB Reader" and the text "No book loaded".

Clicking the button "Choose file" opens a file chooser; selecting a file named "test.epub" (fixture content in Test notes) loads the book; the page shows the text "test.epub", the progress indicator reads "Page 1 of 5", and the reader region shows the text "Hello World".
After loading "test.epub", clicking the button "Next page" once shows "Page 2 of 5" and the reader region shows "Second page".

After loading "test.epub" and clicking "Next page" twice (page 3), clicking the button "Add bookmark" adds one item to the bookmarks list containing the text "Page 3"; the text "No bookmarks" is gone.
After adding the page-3 bookmark, clicking the button "Delete Page 3" removes that item; the bookmarks list shows the text "No bookmarks".
After loading "test.epub" (page 1), clicking the button "Export page" puts exactly "Hello World" on the clipboard and shows the message "Copied page text".

After loading "test.epub" and clicking "Next page" once (page 2, text "Second page"), choosing "Large" in the select labelled "Font size" makes the computed font size of the reader region strictly larger than it was with the default option, while the page text is still "Second page".
After loading "test.epub" and clicking "Next page" twice, reloading the page shows the text "test.epub", the reader region shows "Third page", and the progress indicator reads "Page 3 of 5".
After loading "test.epub", moving to page 3 and adding a bookmark, reloading keeps "test.epub" and the bookmarks list shows an item containing "Page 3".
